# streamtime_secret (Resource)

A secret stored by Streamtime. Its content is never shown in plans or logs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "streamtime_secret" "db_password" {
  path    = "apps/db-password"
  content = var.db_password
}

variable "db_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String, Sensitive) The secret value.
- `path` (String) Where the secret lives, for example apps/db-password. Changing it creates a new secret.

### Optional

- `secret_provider` (String) Where the secret is stored: builtin or vault. Leave it out to use the provider your installation has set as active. Changing it creates a new secret.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Secret ID. Use it to import an existing secret.
- `uri` (String) Reference other resources use to read this secret.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the secret's ID. The secret value is not returned by Streamtime,
# so set `content` in your configuration and apply to write it.
terraform import streamtime_secret.db_password 6f1c2d3e-0000-4000-8000-000000000000
```
